# TaipanMiner v2 floor — codegen composition root (see main.c and
# tm_wire.h). Mirrors breadboard's examples/smoke/main/CMakeLists.txt
# pattern: the composed REQUIRES closure and bb_app_init.c are both
# generated by `bbtool codegen` (see scripts/tm_codegen.py, the pio
# pre: step that drives it) from TM's own bbtool.toml
# [capability.tm_floor]/[board.esp32-wroom32] manifest -- no hand-written
# REQUIRES list, no additive union.
#
# generated/bb_app_init.c is gitignored (build artifact, never committed,
# same convention breadboard's own examples use) and absent by default --
# main.c calls bb_app_init_early()/bb_app_init_rest(), so a plain
# `pio run -e esp32-wroom32` REQUIRES scripts/tm_codegen.py to have run
# first (wired as extra_scripts = pre: in platformio.ini).
set(TM_GENERATED_APP_INIT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/bb_app_init.c")
set(_tm_srcs "main.c" "tm_wire.c")
if(EXISTS "${TM_GENERATED_APP_INIT}")
    list(APPEND _tm_srcs "generated/bb_app_init.c")
endif()

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.breadboard/cmake/bb_generated.cmake")
bb_include_generated_or_fail(TM_GENERATED_FRAGMENT
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/bb_autowire_components.cmake"
    "TaipanMiner: run `python3 .breadboard/scripts/bbtool.py codegen ...` "
    "(see scripts/tm_codegen.py) before building.")

# Stale-fragment guard, mirroring examples/smoke/main/CMakeLists.txt: the
# fragment is board-specific (BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD, also emitted by codegen) --
# a stale fragment from a prior codegen run for a DIFFERENT board would
# otherwise silently link the wrong closure. Skipped during ESP-IDF's
# REQUIRES-only early-expansion pass, where FIRMWARE_BOARD (set via
# board_build.cmake_extra_args in platformio.ini) is not yet populated.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    if(NOT DEFINED BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD OR NOT BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD STREQUAL FIRMWARE_BOARD)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "TaipanMiner: stale generated/bb_autowire_components.cmake -- resolved for "
            "board '${BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD}' but building FIRMWARE_BOARD "
            "'${FIRMWARE_BOARD}'. Re-run codegen for this board before building.")
    endif()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${_tm_srcs}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES ${BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES}
)
